purpose: Outcome-blind APBP site-to-SCAR ADD land matching after diagnosing the v1 Esri-ring reconstruction failure.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Only site coordinates, species identity, and temporal-coverage metadata are used. Population trend direction/endpoints are unopened.

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

geometry_reconstruction.v1_failure: orientation-based shell/hole assembly produced false spatial gaps despite FeatureServer land hits at known sites
geometry_reconstruction.v2_rule: Reconstruct each Esri multipart polygon by symmetric-difference of all valid rings in native EPSG:3031, avoiding reliance on ring orientation after server reprojection.

anchor_validation.rule: For every anchor-distance where the FeatureServer reports >=1 land feature, the locally reconstructed geometry must also report >=1 land feature. Any contradiction fails Gate 1A before candidate-site matching.

spatial_match_audit.selection_rule: Choose the smallest distance at which at least 95% of candidate sites have one or more land-polygon matches and no more than 5% have multiple land-polygon matches. If no distance satisfies both criteria, Gate 1A fails.

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1B minimal island-architecture traits
traits: distance to continental land for offshore islands
